definitions.explanation: A large or important church or religious building, especially one serving as the principal church of a diocese. Also used for Confucian temples in Japanese historical contexts.

examples.japanese: {聖堂|せいどう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{祈|いの}る→祈る：01198_inoru⟧。
⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{聖堂|せいどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ステンド⟦グラス→グラス：00076_gurasu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しかった→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: The stained glass of the old cathedral was beautiful.

examples.japanese: ⟦パリ→パリ：25088_pari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ノートルダム⟦{大聖堂|だいせいどう}→大聖堂：20731_daiseidou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界的|せかいてき}→世界的：20935_sekaiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{建築物|けんちくぶつ}→建築物：21292_kenchikubutsu⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: The Notre-Dame Cathedral in Paris is a world-famous architectural monument.

notes:
{聖堂|せいどう} combines {聖|せい} (holy) and {堂|どう} (hall). It has two main uses depending on context.

USAGE:
1. Christian context: a church or cathedral
2. Japanese history: a Confucian temple, notably {湯島聖堂|ゆしませいどう} in Tokyo

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{大聖堂|だいせいどう}→大聖堂：20731_daiseidou⟧: cathedral (principal church of a diocese)
- {聖堂|せいどう}⟦{騎士|きし}→騎士：14716_kishi⟧: knight (of a holy order)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{教会|きょうかい}→教会：01387_kyoukai⟧: church (general term for Christian worship)
- ⟦{寺院|じいん}→寺院：00122_jiin⟧: Buddhist temple
- ⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧: Shinto shrine
- ⟦{礼拝堂|れいはいどう}→礼拝堂：22105_reihaidou⟧: chapel

{聖堂|せいどう} implies a larger, more important building than ⟦{教会|きょうかい}→教会：01387_kyoukai⟧.
